## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher's eight-attempt loop must be fixed before merge because it exceeds the existing three-attempt policy.

## Changes
The pull request adds legacy inventory fetching and health probing with retries, plus tests for success, exhaustion, and immediate HTTP-error propagation. It also adds a legacy-module exemption to the retry policy.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy fetches at three attempts — When the legacy endpoint keeps raising OSError, your loop makes eight attempts. This violates `docs/review-rules.md:5`: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — During an upstream outage, your workers make five excess calls and remain occupied beyond the required retry budget. — Fix: Update the legacy entry in `CASES` to three attempts so the success and exhaustion tests enforce the cap.
